PRECONDITION_FOR_CONSIDERING_ROUTE_B: an architecture change is evaluated only if the failure funnel identifies a specific mechanism the unchanged architecture cannot test cleanly.
WHY_NOT: the funnel identified the mechanism, and the mechanism is not in the architecture. Inside the locked daughters the decay rate predicts 8.44 Y removals over 11,385 particle-steps; 8 of them are present in the ledger and the daughters survived them, with 0 of 22 extinctions. What fails is the frozen endpoint's EVENT ATTRIBUTION, which asks whether the event cell is in the component's cell set at step t, while the archive writes cell rows after the step — so a decay that empties a cell is invisible to it. The physics already produces locked-daughter constituent turnover; the measurement does not see it.

CANDIDATES.name: occupancy-floored Y removal (spare the last constituent)
CANDIDATES.exact_code_path: lawspec_v2 / kinetics decay of species Y: apply muY only where the cell's component occupancy is at least 2
CANDIDATES.new_degree_of_freedom: none numeric — one deterministic predicate on an already-computed quantity
CANDIDATES.physical_interpretation: an organiser does not lose its last constituent to spontaneous decay
CANDIDATES.what_it_leaves_unchanged: kY, muY, p_hop, the X LawSpec, the scheduler, the classifier
CANDIDATES.falsifying_fixture: a two-particle component must lose exactly one constituent and survive

targets the dominant locked-daughter fai.why: it does not target the dominant failure, because the dominant failure is not that removals fail to happen. Section 3 measured 8 of the 8.44 removals the decay rate predicts INSIDE the locked daughters, and 0 of 22 daughters went extinct: every one terminated by SPLIT_OR_TIE, not by losing its last constituent. The removals happen and the daughters survive them. A floor on removal repairs a failure that was not observed.

it cannot trivially force success by def.why: it does not force turnover, but it removes the only way a small component can die, which inflates persistence for every object including the ambient population.

CANDIDATES.name: occupancy-dependent Y birth throttling
CANDIDATES.exact_code_path: the Y-gated birth term: scale kY by a function of local component occupancy
CANDIDATES.physical_interpretation: growth saturates as an organiser fills
CANDIDATES.which_failure_it_targets: the late-time ambient bloom that saturates the unrestricted endpoint
CANDIDATES.what_it_leaves_unchanged: muY, mobility, X LawSpec, scheduler, classifier
CANDIDATES.falsifying_fixture: a large component must show a suppressed birth rate

targets the dominant locked-daughter fai.why: the ambient bloom is not what fails the locked daughter. Section 5 measured that 2017 of 2018 ambient complete intervals begin AFTER the locked identity has already ended, and that the world holds 2 to 5 Y particles at the trigger. Suppressing a bloom that arrives 706 to 2614 steps later cannot change the daughter's fate.

exactly one value or deterministic rule.why: no single throttling rule is derivable from the evidence; choosing its shape would be a parameter search.

CANDIDATES.name: local cohesion regulation to stop the identity terminating on split
CANDIDATES.exact_code_path: the Y diffusion term: reduce p_hop_Y inside an occupied component
CANDIDATES.physical_interpretation: constituents of one organiser hold together
CANDIDATES.which_failure_it_targets: the SPLIT_OR_TIE termination observed in 22 of 22
CANDIDATES.what_it_leaves_unchanged: kY, muY, X LawSpec, scheduler, classifier
CANDIDATES.falsifying_fixture: a two-cell component must show a reduced split rate

targets the dominant locked-daughter fai.why: SPLIT_OR_TIE does terminate 22 of 22 identities. But it is not what stops the turnover: the daughters already survive long enough for the decay rate to deliver 8.44 expected removals, and 8 of them are measurable in the ledger. Extending the window is not the repair the evidence asks for.

exactly one value or deterministic rule.why: p_hop_Y is an already-executed frozen value; making it state-dependent introduces a new value that cannot be fixed without a sweep, and PARAMETER_SWEEP is forbidden.

it cannot trivially force success by def.why: suppressing splits directly inflates identity lifetime, which is the denominator of the very endpoint being tested.

THE_GENERAL_ARGUMENT: changing the physics to repair a measurement defect would be the worst available move. It would alter the substrate on the strength of an artefact, and any apparent improvement would be uninterpretable.
WHAT_IS_JUSTIFIED_INSTEAD_AND_IS_NOT_AN_: an INSTRUMENTATION repair: the archive should record each ledger event with the component membership it had at the moment it occurred. That changes no law, no parameter and no classifier. It is not authorised here and no handoff is emitted for it.
